quests.name: Gathering Leather
quests.text: Bring 12 pieces of Light Leather to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Investigate the Scourge of Thunder Bluff
quests.text: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside Thunder Bluff and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

quests.name: Traditions of the Bluff
quests.text: Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.  Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.

quests.name: Kodo Hide Bag
quests.text: Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Veteran Uzzek
quests.text: Speak with Uzzek at Far Watch Post.

quests.name: Call of Fire
quests.text: Find Kranal Fiss in the Barrens.

quests.name: Speak with Un'thuwa
quests.text: Speak with Un'thuwa.

quests.name: Hex of Weakness
quests.text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Touch of Weakness
quests.text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.text: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: Heeding the Call
quests.text: Speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Body and Heart
quests.text: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.  Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.

quests.name: The Hunter's Path
quests.text: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.

quests.name: The Hunter's Path
quests.text: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.text: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: Preparation for Ceremony
quests.text: Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.text: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: Until Death Do Us Part
quests.text: Place Clarice's Pendant on Yuriv's Tomb in Silverpine.

quests.name: A Lesson to Learn
quests.text: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Forsaken Aid
quests.text: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Journey to Tarren Mill
quests.text: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: The Ashenvale Hunt
quests.text: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

quests.name: Call of Water
quests.text: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Speak with Ruga
quests.text: Speak with Ruga Ragetotem.

quests.name: Shadowguard
quests.text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Dark Sacrifice
quests.text: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.text: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Blood of Innocents
quests.text: Bring 5 Vials of Innocent Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
quests.text: Bring Lydon's Toxin to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Flying Machine Airport
quests.text: Bring the Toxic Fogger to the Venture Co. sky port, then return to Apothecary Zamah.

quests.name: Never Coming Back
quests.text: Kill 6 Shadowhorn Stag and 6 Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.

quests.name: The Sacred Flame
quests.text: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: The Sacred Flame
quests.text: Deliver the Filled Etched Phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

quests.name: The Sacred Flame
quests.text: Retrieve the Cloven Hoof for Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post.

quests.name: Melor Sends Word
quests.text: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Steelsnap
quests.text: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Chimaeric Horn
quests.text: Bring a Galvanized Horn to Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Call of Air
quests.text: Find Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: The Islander
quests.text: Speak with Klannoc Macleod.

quests.name: Frostmaw
quests.text: Bring Frostmaw's Mane to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Journey to the Marsh
quests.text: Speak with Tabetha.

quests.name: Return to the Marsh
quests.text: Speak with Tabetha.

quests.name: The Platinum Discs
quests.text: Take the reward voucher to Bena Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Portents of Uldum
quests.text: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Seeing What Happens
quests.text: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.

quests.name: Return to Thunder Bluff
quests.text: Speak with Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: A Future Task
quests.text: Speak with Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Un'Goro Soil
quests.text: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Morrowgrain Research
quests.text: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Morrowgrain Research
quests.text: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.  Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Elemental Mastery
quests.text: Collect a sample of air, fire, earth and water for Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

quests.name: A Troubled Spirit
quests.text: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the entrance to the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: The Hunter's Charm
quests.text: Speak to Ogtinc in Azshara.

quests.name: Cenarion Aid
quests.text: Seek out Ogtinc in Azshara.

quests.name: Torwa Pathfinder
quests.text: Speak with Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The New Frontier
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.

quests.name: Rabine Saturna
quests.text: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

quests.name: The Horde Needs Your Help!
quests.text: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

quests.name: Dearest Elenia,
quests.text: Deliver the Carefully Written Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Festival of Fire
quests.text: Touch the bonfires within Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and the Undercity, then speak to a Festival Talespinner within the capital cities.

quests.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
quests.text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Dancing for Marzipan
quests.text: Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Pala, and in exchange you'll receive Thunder Bluff Marzipan!

quests.name: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
quests.text: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.

quests.name: Stealing Ironforge's Flame
quests.text: Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.

quests.name: Stealing Darnassus's Flame
quests.text: Return the Flame of Darnassus to the Festival Talespinner.
